caseNameFull: Dravo Contracting Co. v. James, State Tax Commissioner
attorneys: Messrs. Wm.' S. Moorhead, Lawrence D. Blair, W. Chapman Revercomb, and W. Elliott Nefflen for petitioner. Messrs. Clarence W. Meadows, Attorney General of West Virginia, and W. Holt Wooddell, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit denied. Mr. Justice Reéd took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
